thesis: The most valuable conversion mechanism on this site is the coverage-check form, which is the primary entry point for visitors to determine eligibility and proceed to purchase. However, this mechanism is bleeding value due to unclear form field labels, ambiguous submit button text, and duplicate form instances on the same page, all of which create friction and confusion at the critical moment of engagement.

findings.title: Value proposition is generic
findings.summary: The hero headline promises reliability but fails to explain what the product is or why it's better, lacking visitor-centric benefit.
findings.problem: The hero headline promises reliability but fails to explain what the product is or why it's better, lacking visitor-centric benefit.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Wireless Home Internet for Rural and On-the-Go; notes: Lead with concrete benefit like unlimited data or no contracts.
findings.evidence: Reliable Internet That Works Anywhere in the U.S. | Internet That Just Works
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Unclear form field labels
findings.summary: Form fields lack explicit labels, so visitors don't know what data is required before engaging.
findings.problem: Form fields lack explicit labels, so visitors don't know what data is required before engaging.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Add explicit, visible labels above each field.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Ambiguous form submit label
findings.summary: The CONTINUE button label does not set expectations for the next step, adding cognitive effort at conversion.
findings.problem: The CONTINUE button label does not set expectations for the next step, adding cognitive effort at conversion.
findings.recommended_change: cta: Check My Coverage; notes: Replace with descriptive action.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Duplicate pricing creates comparison ambiguity
findings.summary: The same plan prices appear twice with different formatting, causing ambiguity about which price applies to which tier.
findings.problem: The same plan prices appear twice with different formatting, causing ambiguity about which price applies to which tier.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Consolidate pricing display to a single consistent format per plan tier.
findings.evidence: A section heading reads “$99.95 /month”. | A section heading reads “$129.95 /month”. | Prices shown on the page: $99.95 /month $129.95 /month $99.95/mo $0.00 $99.95 $99.99
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Repeated identical form instances
findings.summary: Two identical CONTINUE forms on each page create confusion about which to complete, increasing abandonment.
findings.problem: Two identical CONTINUE forms on each page create confusion about which to complete, increasing abandonment.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Consolidate into a single coverage-check form per page.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: One-time costs appear separately
findings.summary: One-time charges are listed separately from monthly prices, causing visitors to overlook them until later.
findings.problem: One-time charges are listed separately from monthly prices, causing visitors to overlook them until later.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Combine into single price summary line per plan.
findings.evidence: A section heading reads “$0.00 (one-time)”. | A section heading reads “$99.99 (one-time)”. | Prices shown on the page: $99.95 /month $129.95 /month $99.95/mo $0.00 $99.95 $99.99
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: No shipping fee disclosure
findings.summary: Shipping costs are not mentioned, leaving a cost unknown until later in checkout.
findings.problem: Shipping costs are not mentioned, leaving a cost unknown until later in checkout.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Display shipping cost or 'free shipping' badge.
findings.evidence: Prices shown on the page: $99.95/month $129.95/month $99.95/Mo $99.95/month $129.95/month $99.95 | Page copy reads “Existing Customers: [Pay Bill](https://nomadinternet.com/pages/pay-now) \| [Submit Ticket](mailto:support@nom”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Rural page title misleads destination
findings.summary: The page title 'How Nomad Internet Works - YouTube' does not match the page content, disorienting users mid-funnel.
findings.problem: The page title 'How Nomad Internet Works - YouTube' does not match the page content, disorienting users mid-funnel.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Update title to reflect rural internet content.
findings.evidence: The browser title reads “How Nomad Internet Works - YouTube”. | A section heading reads “Nomad Internet: The Go-To For Rural Internet”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Guarantee claim lacks visible backing
findings.summary: The 'SHOP WITH CONFIDENCE' claim has no visible guarantee or return policy, leaving it unsupported at point of purchase.
findings.problem: The 'SHOP WITH CONFIDENCE' claim has no visible guarantee or return policy, leaving it unsupported at point of purchase.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Add visible money-back guarantee or return policy statement.
findings.evidence: A section heading reads “SHOP WITH CONFIDENCE”. | 5 distinct calls to action compete on the same page: “CHECK COVERAGE”, “Watch on”, “SEE WHAT I QUALIFY FOR”, “START CHAT”, “CHECK MY COVERAGE”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift
